peer_identity.arc_label: The cloned revival of Don Nicanor—publicly coherent but privately memory-unstable; eventually killed again
peer_identity.honcho_notes: Commanding public orator: inspires large parliamentary crowds with ideological speeches. Post-revival: dangerous private memory instability—fails to recognize his own daughter in private while appearing coherent in public. Makes delusional romantic advances toward Aina Vicenta Gabriela. A trial of socialization was required before full public reintegration. In vol13 paternal memory is restored when he receives Vicenta's self-removed eye—overwhelmed with horror and remorse, weeps and begs forgiveness. Performs public dawn ecological meditation as federation president. Refuses Technoclergy bikramen ultimatum; Philodendra bombarded. Killed during the Metabaron/Petro castle assault in vol14.
peer_identity.rationale: The vol13 record (don_nicanor_rosamel_de_rokha) explicitly labels 'Clone' as a trait—not an inference. It continues the vol12 clone arc directly: same memory instability toward Dona Vicenta, same clone origin via Melmoth, same political role as federation president. Paternal recognition is restored mid-vol13 by Vicenta's eye-sacrifice, then the same clone commands Philodendran forces in vol14 (still failing to recognize her initially) before being killed during the castle assault. The underscore character_id variant is a formatting artifact from extraction; the entity is identical to don-nicanor__clone.
